title: 我記得要記住，但唔記得要記住咩
caption:
有啲嘢唔係唔記得
係記得自己要記住，但唔記得要記住咩 😂

Some things aren’t forgotten
I remember needing to remember—I just can’t remember what 😂

你最近有冇試過？留言話俾我知，或者 Tag 個成日話「我記得㗎」嘅朋友！
Ever had this moment? Tell me below or tag that friend who always says “I remember!”
